scope: Taiwan-first opportunity discovery; no build or paid-pilot recommendation

claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan e-commerce buyer/finance role is explicit in Tasker and 104 listings.
claim_audit.problem: Observed: multi-channel invoice, settlement, refund/allowance and monthly-close work is described in an external buyer request and paid job duties.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: 2026-08-28 Tasker buyer requests long-term outsourcing after removing an internal finance role; this is a recent demand-side signal.
claim_audit.recurrence: Observed/inferred: monthly close is explicit; same-customer month-two recurrence remains Unknown.
claim_audit.standardization: Inferred: channel intake schema, exception taxonomy and handoff checklist can be reused across similar sellers; must be tested.
claim_audit.leverage: Inferred: templates, QA delegation and selective automation could reduce founder-hours; not yet measured.

evidence_items.limitations: one visible request; budget/long-term intent shown by listing, payment completion not independently verified
internal employment proves work and payroll, not SaaS demand
employer need may be solved internally

contradictions: ERP and accountants may already handle sufficient scope
one buyer may represent a narrow segment
unknown whether standardized service survives custom tax/bookkeeping requests
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Obtain redacted sample and a second-month commitment from at least one target seller; compare exception taxonomy across a second seller.

claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan tender-active SMEs and bid staff are represented in PRO360, Tasker and 104.
claim_audit.problem: Observed/inferred: buyers and paid roles handle tender reading, proposal preparation and document/format risk; standalone preflight is inferred from this workflow.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: PRO360 buyer review and Tasker external proposal request support buying external tender help, but not the exact preflight wedge.
claim_audit.recurrence: Inferred: per-tender trigger; target vertical bid frequency is Unknown.
claim_audit.standardization: Inferred: company profile, qualification matrix and attachment checklist can be reused; bid-specific judgment remains custom.
claim_audit.leverage: Inferred: reusable profiles/checklists and delegated QA; founder expertise may still scale linearly.

evidence_items.limitations: request is for proposal writing and includes scope/award terms
internal paid labor cannot alone prove outsourcing
educational source may have selection bias

contradictions: observed buyers may want full proposal writing, not a light preflight
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Run a preflight-only offer in one vertical and record requests, paid commitments and repeat bids.

claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan service buyers and ops/accounting users exist.
claim_audit.problem: Observed: manual key-in and inconsistent PDFs are costly/slow; external service supply exists.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: Tasker service market and prior archived buyer requests; recent same-buyer repeat is Unknown.
claim_audit.recurrence: Unknown; visible requests are mostly one-off batches.
claim_audit.standardization: Inferred only if one document family is selected.
claim_audit.leverage: Inferred via scripts/QA; founder-labor risk remains medium-high.

evidence_items.limitations: provider supply/pricing is not demand volume

contradictions: provider has no visible completed transaction on page
document formats may be too heterogeneous
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Find two buyers in the same document family with recurring files.

claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan contractors/subcontractors and paid estimator/billing roles.
claim_audit.problem: Observed: external requests and job duties cover quantity takeoff, estimate, progress evidence and billing.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: Tasker buyer requests; more independent recent buyer requests are required before ranking strongest.
claim_audit.recurrence: Inferred: project phases and periodic billing, but repeat customer evidence is weak.
claim_audit.standardization: Unknown for a narrow trade; general scope is bespoke.
claim_audit.leverage: Unknown; professional judgment likely keeps labor linear.

evidence_items.limitations: internal work does not prove outsourcing

contradictions: custom measurement and expertise may dominate
one marketplace category may overstate breadth
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Test one trade-specific billing packet and measure whether the same buyer returns for the next phase.

claim_audit.buyer: Observed: Taiwan buyers request recurring public-data collection, but the common vertical is not identified.
claim_audit.problem: Observed: requests seek periodic collection/updates; exact painful decision workflow is Unknown.
claim_audit.externalizability: Observed: Tasker buyer requests for periodic automation; not enough to establish one product category.
claim_audit.recurrence: Observed for individual requests (twice-monthly / half-yearly), but cross-customer recurrence is Unknown.
claim_audit.standardization: Potentially high for a single source and field set; not yet demonstrated.
claim_audit.leverage: Potentially high through scheduled collection and standardized reports.

evidence_items.limitations: heterogeneous requests; same product wedge not established

contradictions: custom scraper projects may not repeat
claim_audit.next_evidence_to_collect: Locate three buyers with the same source, fields and update trigger.

strongest_evidence: Recent Taiwan buyer explicitly requests long-term outsourcing of multi-channel reconciliation and monthly handoff.
Independent Taiwan job listings repeatedly pay for the same e-commerce reconciliation workflow.
Taiwan tender services have buyer reviews and external proposal requests, but the preflight-only wedge remains unproven.
weakest_claims: Any exact savings, market size, CAC, conversion, retention or LTV.
Standalone tender preflight willingness to pay.
Repeat purchase and shared schema for generic PDF conversion.
contradictions: Existing accountants, ERP systems and proposal consultants may already satisfy the strongest candidates.
Marketplace demand may be selection-biased toward people actively seeking help.
A recurring workflow can still be a labor-linear service if exceptions dominate.
unsupported_precision: No TAM, CAC, LTV, retention, market-share or conversion estimate is asserted.
critical_unknowns: E-commerce month-two repeat and fixed-scope acceptance
Tender preflight-only purchase and vertical bid frequency
Exception rate and founder-hours per e-commerce close
Whether any PDF/document family repeats across customers
next_evidence_to_collect: Run low-cost behavioral tests: fixed-scope e-commerce close first, tender preflight second, and record sample sharing, payment/commitment and repeat requests.
